written: 2026-10-31, before any carry backtest was run
note: Append-only. Every configuration evaluated on the backtest window is listed here and counts toward the deflated Sharpe ratio. Sensitivities re-run the primary under other cost assumptions and are not trials.

window.daily: 2024-07-01..2026-10-30 (current funding rules; the forecasts are out-of-sample from 2024-07)

primary_rationale: The simplest weekly forecast with the best out-of-sample score. L=2.5 survives a +33% rally under the strict PM interpretation, with daily rebalancing and intraday deleveraging above ratio 0.80.
gating_rule: Decide daily at 00:00 UTC from the latest forecast strictly before. F = forecast mean hourly funding x 8760. F >= borrow + 2% -> L_hi; F >= 2% -> 1.0; 0 <= F < 2% -> keep the current position if invested (hysteresis), else 0; F < 0 -> 0 (flat).
